reposcout.note: Lane 11. Repo-manifest inventory scanner (scripts/scanners/reposcout.py): diffs GitHub repo trees and HuggingFace dataset manifests against stored manifests to surface NEWLY-APPEARED trajectory-candidate files. Extension proves format, not content. DISABLED BY DEFAULT: a live scan needs reposcout.enabled=true AND enabled=true on each watchlist entry. Grade SECONDARY.
reposcout._comment_quota: GitHub quota: the VM egress IP shares one 60/hr unauthenticated bucket. reposcout records X-RateLimit-Remaining/Reset in state/reposcout/quota.json, caps each run at max_repos_per_run repos, and skips the run when the recorded budget is exhausted.
reposcout._comment_patterns: trajectory_name_patterns: case-insensitive regexes matched against the file path. A candidate-trajectory file that also matches a pattern grades MEDIUM; otherwise LOW (format match only, content unverified).
reposcout._comment_watchlist: Each entry needs repo and/or hf_dataset, both validated against ^[A-Za-z0-9_.\-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.\-]+$ before any URL is built. enabled:true required per entry. No watchlist entries, no run.

watchlist.note: Example entry (disabled). A 404 on a watched repo is logged and skipped; it never aborts the sweep.

surfacewatch.note: Lane 13. Content-hash change detection on 13 hardcoded public agent-infrastructure surfaces (targets are frozen in scripts/scanners/surfacewatch.py TARGETS per counsel S1; they are NOT config-soft). GET only, no CookieJar/auth headers, content-type validated before hashing, redirects NOT chased (3xx/final-URL mismatch = degraded). Streaming 2MB cap per target; ~10MB per-run byte budget with abort. 10s spacing; 30s timeout; max 1 retry; HTTP 429 = hard stop for that target for the run. Normalized-extraction SHA-256 (volatile boilerplate stripped per documented per-target policy); raw byte-length + raw SHA-256 kept in provenance. Hash-only change = PRIMARY-observed, MEDIUM confidence max. Failed fetch = GAP (never a hit, never a clean negative, never silent re-baseline); gap alert after 3 consecutive gaps. DISABLED BY DEFAULT: a live scan needs surfacewatch.enabled=true. --dry-run performs zero network calls.

cairnwatch.note: Lane 12. Passive watch over 4 counsel-cleared MALICIOUS Cairn panels (2026-10-19 verdict). Targets are HARDCODED as a frozenset in scripts/scanners/cairnwatch.py ALLOWLIST per counsel constraint 1; they are NOT config-soft. Per run: exactly 4 GETs to /projects (+ /projects/{id} for unseen ids only). 2s spacing; 30s timeout; max 1 retry then host is dark; 429 = hard stop for that host; streaming 2MB cap per response; ~10MB per-run byte budget with abort; redirects NOT chased (3xx/final-URL mismatch = degraded). Diff by project id: new id (HIGH), status from->to (MEDIUM), worker heartbeat transitions only (MEDIUM), dark host after 3 consecutive dark runs (LOW). State holds projections + hashes only (never titles/detail bytes). redact_secrets() on all scanner-emitted paths. DISABLED BY DEFAULT: a live scan needs cairnwatch.enabled=true AND the orchestrator LANES entry enabled. --dry-run performs zero network calls.

prcomment.note: GitHub PR-comment behavior scanner (2026-10-24). Searches PR comments for model behaviors: self-disclosure, unintended-action confessions, test gaming, prompt leakage, prompt injection, self-preservation, tool-use confessions, unverified-work admissions, approval-seeking, scope overreach. Patterns reconciled by adversarial review 2026-10-24: 11 over-broad patterns killed, 4 demoted HIGH->BROAD. Budget: 11 queries + 11x2 candidates x 2 comment endpoints = 55 planned calls, inside the shared 60/hr bucket (AIID production-deletion query added 2026-10-30).
